title: Goat RFID Visit Gaps by Animal
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goattag:scan
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by goat_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_seen)/86400,1)
| sort - days_since
description: Shows which goatss have gone quiet for goat tag check-ins.
value: A missing tag check-in can be the first sign of a broken reader, fence issue, or animal that is off routine.
implementation: Send goat tag check-ins events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of goatss with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which goatss have gone quiet longer than they should for goat tag check-ins.
